name: 2-Block Littlestone Dimension of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: The depth-three Littlestone witness queries coordinates 0 and 1 on its first two levels, then coordinates 3,2,2,2 on the four branches. Its first block therefore satisfies the 2-block constraint, proving the lower bound. The ordinary Littlestone dimension is three, proving equality.
references: Directly from the $C_5$ Littlestone witness; see \cite{littlestone1988learning,palvolgyi2021unlabeled}.
